subject: Request: One-off Marketplace Private Offer for Acme - Winback Pricing
participants_external: j.smith@acme.com (James Smith - VP Cloud, Acme Corporation)
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: dealdesk@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: One-off Marketplace Private Offer for Acme - Winback Pricing

Hi Deal Desk team,

Quick note — Acme (James Smith, VP Cloud) is willing to move a set of workloads back to the AWS Marketplace if we can provide a one-time private offer at 35% off list for the first 12 months. This is a winback + expansion motion: if they accept, they commit to $1.2M ARR on-marketplace (50% new workload, 50% returning).

Why this matters: Acme is a high-signal reference (tech buyer, strong case study potential) and the marketplace listing will accelerate co-sell efforts with their AWS account team. The customer has an active procurement window and prefers a marketplace flow.

Request: approval for a 35% private offer (one-time exception) with the following conditions —
- 12-month private offer term; subscription auto-renews at standard list unless renegotiated
- Minimum first-year committed billings: $1.2M (net of discount)
- Standard Redwood T&Cs; use AWS Private Offer flow + DocuSign link for PO

I've attached a short pricing deck and commit projection. We need a response by EOD tomorrow PST to keep momentum with AWS and the customer.

Attachments: acme-winback-pricing-deck.pdf, acme-commit-projection.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: dealdesk@redwood.com (Marissa Cole)
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off Marketplace Private Offer for Acme - Winback Pricing

Laura —

Thanks for the context. A few questions before we escalate for exec sign-off:
1) Please confirm math: is the $1.2M figure pre-discount ARR or expected billed amount after the 35%?
2) Why 35% specifically? Any precedent or comparable marketplace exceptions we should reference?
3) Provide churn history / why we expect this to stick (simple bullets ok).
4) Include the AWS account team contact and the timeline for publishing the private offer.

Looping in Rishi for financial approval and Tessa for channel/co-sell impact.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole | Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
dealdesk@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: dealdesk@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off Marketplace Private Offer for Acme - Winback Pricing

Marissa — answers inline below and attached a signed draft PO (they signed to show intent, not final until private-offer accepted):

1) $1.2M is expected billed amount after discount for year-one net revenue. The list ARR would be ~$1.85M before the 35% discount. See tab 'RevenueCalc' in the attached Excel.

2) 35% is what the AWS account team recommended to make the economics work for the customer vs direct contract (their internal comp model needs ~35% to get landing spot). No exact precedent internally but there was a small EDU exception earlier this year at 30% for renewals (not public).

3) Churn history:
- Left 10 months ago due to performance concerns on self-managed infra; we resolved with dedicated infra + performance tuning in Q2.
- NPS during pilot was 46 and they ran production tests successfully in July. They require marketplace billing for procurement compliance.

4) AWS contact: Priya Rao (priya.rao@amazon.com) is coordinating the co-sell and can publish the private offer once we issue pricing. Timeline: AWS needs final numbers by 11/11 to publish before their internal end-of-quarter commit window.

Attachments: signed-draft-po.pdf (intent), acme-commit-projection.xlsx

Next steps: Rishi, can you confirm P&L impact and whether finance is comfortable making this one-time concession given the committed dollars? Tessa / Vivek — any channel or co-sell concerns?

Thanks,
Laura

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off Marketplace Private Offer for Acme - Winback Pricing

Laura / Marissa —

I reviewed the attached projection. High level takeaways:
- Year-one net recognized revenue at $1.2M after discount looks plausible assuming usage matches projections. We should require a minimum commitment milestone schedule in the PO to protect revenue recognition (suggest quarterly minimums).
- Gross margin: this will compress ~10-12 percentage points in year-one relative to standard list sales due to the 35% discount + marketplace fee. However, the account acquisition cost is low (no direct infra credits) and co-sell uplift + strategic reference potential make this defensible.

Decision: finance is willing to support a one-time 35% private offer conditional on:
- Quarterly committed billing milestones in the DocuSign PO (attach schedule)
- A clawback clause if customer terminates within 6 months without cause (pro-rata repayment or credit reversal)
- Legal to sign off on the final PO language (loop legal if not already)

I'll mark as provisionally approved from a finance perspective; Marissa / Deal Desk to capture the legal/exec approval and route for final sign-off.

-Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com (Deal Desk)
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, priya.rao@amazon.com
Date: 2026-11-10T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off Marketplace Private Offer for Acme - Winback Pricing

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on Rishi's provisional approval and the AWS timeline, I'm escalating to exec approval now. Summary for sign-off notice:
- Offer: 35% one-time private offer via AWS Marketplace for 12 months
- Net-year-one expected billing: $1.2M (post-discount)
- Conditions: quarterly committed milestones; 6-month clawback; legal sign-off on PO; AWS must publish by 11/11 to meet their Q4 commit window

I've attached the final pricing deck (updated), the commit schedule, and the draft PO with placeholder legal language. Please review; exec approval requested by 18:00 PST today so we can push to AWS before their cutoff.

Attachments: acme-winback-pricing-deck.pdf, acme-commit-projection.xlsx, signed-draft-po.pdf

-Marissa Cole
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
dealdesk@redwood.com
